description: Defines wizard classes for opening and filtering timesheet sheets based on department management and states in an Odoo module.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_open
classes.description: Wizard class for opening timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_confirm_open
classes.description: Wizard class for opening draft timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_validate_open
classes.description: Wizard class for opening confirmed timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

methods.name: _open_timesheet
methods.description: Retrieves department members managed by the current user and returns an action to open related timesheets filtered by user and state.
